    fn slide_f32x4<const SHIFT: usize>(self, a: f32x4<Self>, b: f32x4<Self>) -> f32x4<Self> {

            return b;
        }

            dyn_vext_128(
                self.cvt_to_bytes_f32x4(a).val.0,
                self.cvt_to_bytes_f32x4(b).val.0,
                SHIFT * 4usize,

            val: crate::support::Aligned128(result),
            simd: self,
        })
    }
